author: reek
body: Proves the GA selection step. sort-by-fitness reorders a population so the highest-scoring personalities come first, which is what makes evolve-generation breed the winners instead of an arbitrary half (the old stub returned the population untouched). Four tagged personalities scored 1/9/3/7 must come back ordered p2(9), p4(7), p3(3), p1(1). Also checks max-score reports 9.
